code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated erythrocytes, high ferritin, mildly increased CRP, and elevated INR, suggesting possible acute inflammation or infection with hypoxic stress. Elevated creatinine may indicate renal involvement. Low total protein with high albumin could reflect acute phase response or dehydration. Basophilia is noted. Findings warrant urgent clinical correlation for possible severe infection, hypoxemic respiratory failure, and multi-organ involvement. Immediate further evaluation and management are recommended.
